messages:
lina: Hey team — auditor asked for a compact bundle showing how an RBAC change to service-account-ml-prod was approved/deployed and the correlated KMS decrypt events for 2025-03-10 incident. They want a single runbook + example logs we can hand them by EOD.
ashok: I can pull the approval ticket and the git commit. Approval lives in Jira RED-4123; commit is infra/iam@4a9c2b. Will attach.
marta: For logs, we should include both the k8s RoleBinding change event (audit.k8s) and the KMS decrypt audit from CloudAudit. Quick Splunk query I'm going to run: 
```splunk
index=cloud_audit resource.type="cloud_kms_key" protoPayload.methodName="Decrypt" earliest=03/10/2025:00:00:00 latest=03/10/2025:23:59:59 resource.labels.kms_key_id="projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/llm-key" | table _time, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, protoPayload.request, protoPayload.response
```
ashok: Also add the PR link for the RBAC change: https://git.redwood/internal/infra/iam/pulls/1284 — includes playbook link.
secbot: evidence-export: started export job ev-20250310-009; packaging artifacts: jira/RED-4123, git/4a9c2b, k8s-audit-snippet, kms-audit-snippet. Progress: 0/4.
auditor_jen: Quick clarifying Qs from the auditor: 1) they want proof the change was scoped (least privilege) — can you show the evaluation matrix? 2) They want a signed timestamped artifact for the KMS decrypts. 3) Retention: confirm logs retained for 13 months.
marta: For (1) we have the RBAC review doc under /docs/security/rbac-reviews/2025-03-09-ml-sa.md — I'll paste the assessment summary. For (2) we can provide the CloudAudit export .json gz with checksums and signed by ops-ryan using our internal GPG key. For (3) retention is 395 days (logs-retention-policy v2).
ops-ryan: I will sign the export and upload to the evidence S3 bucket with a presigned link. Command I used: 
```bash
# export and sign
auth export --start 2025-03-10 --end 2025-03-10 --type=kms-decrypt > kms-decrypt-20250310.json
gpg --default-key ops@redwood.com --output kms-decrypt-20250310.json.sig --detach-sign kms-decrypt-20250310.json
aws s3 cp kms-decrypt-20250310.json s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-03-10/
aws s3 cp kms-decrypt-20250310.json.sig s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-03-10/
```
ashok: I'll assemble a 1-page runbook: timeline, approval links, commit, PR, kube audit excerpt, kms excerpt, signature hash. Drafting now in drive: https://drive.redwood/internal/evidence/1751112223-runbook-draft
marta: Splunk snippet I ran returned 3 decrypt events matching the service account principal (service-account-ml-prod@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com). I'll paste sanitized snippet in the runbook and include the full signed export.
secbot: evidence-export: progress 2/4 (k8s-audit-snippet, kms-audit-snippet added).
auditor_jen: Also can you map this to control CC-3.2 and ISO A.9.4? They need the control traceability matrix.
lina: Good catch — I'll map the artifacts to CC-3.2 (change control), CC-6.1 (logging), ISO A.9.4 (access rights) in the runbook appendix.
ops-ryan: Uploaded signed bundle: s3://redwood-evidence/audits/2025-03-10/evidence-bundle-1751112223.tar.gz (presigned link expires in 7 days). Checksum: sha256: d4b3f8...
ashok: Draft runbook updated with appendix mapping controls to artifacts. Asking security review: marta, can you quick-check and then I'll send to auditor_jen?
marta: Reviewed, minor wording tweak. Done.
secbot: evidence-export: completed. job ev-20250310-009 status=success artifacts=4
auditor_jen: Thanks — please send the presigned link + the one-page runbook and the signed audit export. Auditor will confirm receipt and may request a small sample of the raw logs for forensics.
lina: Sending now. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
